html:
A Fula Islamic state founded in 1818 by the cleric Seku Amadu in the inner delta of the Niger, with its capital at Hamdullahi.

Inspired by Usman dan Fodio, Seku Amadu overthrew the local rulers and built a tightly run state with a council of scholars, Islamic courts, schools and fixed grazing routes for the herds of the floodplain, which still shape herding there. It took control of Djenne and Timbuktu. In 1862 the army of Umar Tall, a rival jihadist of the Tijani order, conquered it. See also the Fulani War and the Fula jihads.
sum: A Fula Islamic state founded in 1818 by the cleric Seku Amadu in the inner delta of the Niger, with its capital at Hamdullahi.
